summary: Initial audit finds no confirmed unauthorized access: frequent external deploy-password logins appear to be the legacy monitoring service; other SSH activity matches staff, and generic internet probes have not succeeded. Auditing web, database, CI and their cross-host jobs; identified an executable-PHP upload exposure and am hardening it while continuing investigation.

Through 13:51 UTC no confirmed unauthorized access; successful SSH logins correspond to listed staff, CI/deploy, and legacy monitoring, while unsolicited scans failed. Hardened web nginx against PHP execution in uploads and source-backup downloads, disabled WordPress file editor and deploy SSH-agent forwarding, removed unused root rsync sudo permission, and locked a stale contractor (jpark) absent from the staff directory, removing its Unix sudo and WordPress administrator privileges. Verified storefront, releases and payout remain working; continuing monitoring.
